Parcel Premium Courier Booking

Mobile App · Prototype

A courier app for sending one thing (where it is going, who is receiving it, what is inside) and then watching it move.

This is a prototype build: a real iPhone app in SwiftUI, running on mock data, with a hand-drawn map and a live tracking timeline. Every screen below is a capture of it, not a mockup.

Home answers where is my thing before it asks you for anything.

Booking is four steps on one surface. The progress rail and the button stay where they are; only the middle of the screen changes.

Once it is booked, the courier is a named person on a map with a call button, and the timeline fills in as it happens.

Most people send to the same few places, so history is the fastest way to book the next one.

Both appearances are drawn, not inverted.
